provenance.scope: PRTS community review, not official documentation or gameplay execution. Native references retain their own input/version boundaries.

sources.title: 山
sources.section: 第一天赋 巨力重拳及备注
sources.finding: The talent rolls per attack rather than per damage; its scale and debuff share the successful attack outcome.

sources.title: 赤刃明霄陈
sources.section: 第一天赋 形意洞照，弱点伤害说明
sources.finding: Physical/magical packets choose a type per target using silent physical and magical formula estimates or target fixed weakness; the probes exclude receiving modifiers and damage resets.

sources.title: 逻各斯
sources.section: 第二天赋 剜魂具辞及备注
sources.finding: Target debuff contributes +150 (or +165) input for magical damage after attack scaling and before RES; affects the applying attack and even zero-input magical damage. This is not post-defense fragile.

sources.title: 羽毛笔
sources.finding: Against target below half HP, obtains temporary ATK and recomputes theoretical damage with this packet scale and current defense/penetration, then overwrites packet amount. Earlier amount adjustments disappear, so final amount can decrease. Temporary ATK persists until successful damage, another target output, or next frame.

sources.title: 拉普兰德
sources.finding: Skill changes attack damage to magical, adds a target and removes ranged scale penalty. It establishes type configuration during the mode, without proving a per-damage side effect is needed.

sources.title: 铃兰
sources.section: 第二天赋 画地为牢
sources.finding: Grants fragile to slowed targets in range; fragile filters physical/magical/true damage and takes the highest same-name strength.

sources.title: 伤判效果
sources.finding: Fragile and sanctuary are normally target receiving modifiers after defense/RES. Ordered processing and each modifier's conditions are semantically relevant. This does not justify a target pre-formula hook.

sources.title: 事件
sources.finding: Distinguishes source/target pre-formula events, native after-calculate cleanup of temporary penetration, and source output damage for La Pluma recalculation. Source-less and precalculated damage differ in event eligibility.

sources.title: 伤害分类
sources.section: 伤害属性、其他特征、弱点伤害
sources.finding: Damage type, attack type and application way are independent. Ordinary/skill attack damage excludes attached Buff damage. Precomputed and already-computed packets have different formula/event behavior; no-source eligibility cannot be inferred from targetability. Weakness is per packet and silent; existing native case retains an atkAddition mismatch.

sources.url: https://prts.wiki/w/伤害分类#攻击附加效果
facts: Configured attack Buffs precede the attack's own damage; configured elemental buildup follows it.
Every strike in a multistrike can attach its Buff.
Talent-added attack Buffs have a different source-presence condition from Buffs configured directly on the attack.
sources.nativeCrossCheck: Case27 confirms the Nymph chain; generic public hit Hook necessity does not follow from native names.

facts: Attack SP recovery is per eligible attack; multistrike normally recovers on each attack, with the Swordmaster double-strike exception.
limits: This page does not establish the exact pre-windup versus release instruction position.

sources.section: 情绪吸收 and correction footnote
facts: PRTS corrects the in-game attack wording to successful damage output, and separately describes SP granted after killing an enemy.
limits: Native template for Amiya was not extracted in this finite investigation.

facts: Any self-output damage can trigger trait healing; the trait also has a short accumulation window, count cap based on block count, and separated actual healing intervals.
limits: Exact cancellation and invulnerability qualification requires native cross-check.

facts: Trait healing is tied to damage output and is not restricted to attacks; some Musha impose extra qualifying conditions.
limits: Do not silently move this to successful-damage-after based only on colloquial lifesteal wording.

facts: Kill credit yields DP. Kill attribution is not identical to damage-source attribution.
Incantation healing requires successful damage and a healing target. Its numeric basis is determined before actual damage application and is damage value rather than observed HP loss.
Base talent depends on personal kills; upgraded module instead observes enemy defeats in nearby tiles. This distinguishes credited kills from other units' nearby deaths.
PRTS distinguishes damage output from successful-damage-after.
limits: Page marks itself incomplete; native case27 supplies the concrete event ordering instead.

historicalNative.limit: Historical weak-damage extraction; not revalidated against November DLL. Case expressly leaves concrete crit ordering and atkAddition discrepancy open.

historicalNative.finding: Current source/target pre-formula callbacks and source after-calculate exist; target callback is also run in the no-source reference calculation. Callback count therefore cannot define actual damage or hit count.

limits: How target Logos atkAddition participates in current weak comparison is explicitly disputed between old ordinary native and PRTS; no conclusion on precise composition order.
Mountain crit content priority relative to weak-damage conversion is not proven by equal template priority, and old generic next-attack talent cannot be assumed to bind Mountain.
La Pluma is community evidence here; exact temporary ATK scope and all special runtime paths were not re-extracted.
